reasoning_traces.think:
The synthesis integrates two distinct layers: a prescriptive layer (0207) that computes risk-neutral optimal actions based on win probability surfaces, and a descriptive layer (1575) that models actual coach behavior through quantile-MDP inverse learning. These layers form a dual system where the prescriptive layer provides an idealized recommendation, while the descriptive layer captures behavioral deviations. The composition of these layers enables the engine to compute a WP-gap between optimal and predicted actions, forming the basis for a coach decision audit. The τ̂ layer reflects risk preferences that vary across coaches and regions, necessitating dynamic re-fitting each season. This dualism mirrors the duality between theoretical optimization and empirical behavior, with the audit serving as a measure of deviation from rationality. Failure modes include static τ̂ values that do not adapt to changing environments, leading to misalignment between recommendations and actual decisions.
